criteria.text: Identifies the threatened $450,000 claim by Redcliffe Systems Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.5 is stated as $25,200,000 but 10% of the $210,000,000 Purchase Price is $21,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 60-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Identifies that the 5-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Flags that the board minutes and the disclosure letter are inconsistent about litigation.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (10% x $210,000,000 = $21,000,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $25,200,000.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
